messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — Escalation fired for service=hosted-inference-east-1, alert=api-latency-spike, incident=inc_1769995555. Primary on-call: @Raj Patel. Escalation policy: secondary after 3m, then manager. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/inc_1769995555 :rotating_light:

Raj Patel: acked. I'm on it. Starting investigation — collecting request traces and p50/p95.

Maria Chen: seeing increased tail latency on the inference pods. Metric spikes on tokens/sec queue and cpu. Graph: https://grafana.example/d/hosted-inf/latency?panelId=7

Oliver Park: pagerduty shows secondary didn't ack within window, manager will get page next. Maria, can you check pod logs for OOM/evictions?

Maria Chen: quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:06:12Z host-inf-3 kubelet: EvictionThresholdExceeded memory.available 3%
2026-03-15T02:06:14Z model-server: ERROR out-of-memory while allocating KV cache for sequence_len=4096
```
Looks like a memory pressure pattern across ~2 pods. Not all.

Raj Patel: confirming customer-facing errors: support traces show increased 503 responses from the ingest LB. Example curl:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 3
{"error":"backend_unavailable"}
```

Support-Bot: Support queue tags: #hosted-inference-east-1-high-latency — 12 customer reports in last 10m, highest impact: small- to mid-sized SaaS clients experiencing request failures.

Raj Patel: I'm going to cordon the most impacted node and shift traffic off those pods. Maria, can you prepare a hot-redeploy (rolling restart) of the model-server with reduced KV cache size?

Maria Chen: on it. Command I'll run:
```bash
kubectl -n hosted-inference rollout restart deployment/model-server-east-1
# then patch config to kv_cache_max_entries=256
kubectl -n hosted-inference set env deployment/model-server-east-1 KV_CACHE_MAX=256
```
Will monitor memory usage.

Oliver Park: tagging manager since PD escalated: @Karen Lee (Manager) — you're getting this page next; heads-up that we may need to trigger cross-region failover if restarts don't stabilize.

incident-bot: PagerDuty — Manager escalation triggered (Karen Lee).

Karen Lee (Manager): got the page (via SMS). Just woke up, logging in. If primary fixes aren't quick, approve failover to eu-west1 warm pool. Do we have capacity?

Raj Patel: eu-west1 reserved pool has ~40% spare capacity. We can cutover ~10% of traffic to start. I'll prepare a canary shift via traffic manager.

Maria Chen: restart started — pods are cycling, memory usage dropping on new replicas. Initial p95 latency improving from 1.2s -> 350ms on the newly spun pods.

Oliver Park: good sign. While rolling we should also reduce per-request token budget for a few minutes to lower pressure: set default_max_tokens=256 via config flag.

Raj Patel: applying temporary throttling:
```bash
redwoodctl config set hosted-inference-east-1 default_max_tokens=256 --scope=route
redwoodctl traffic shift --from=hosted-inference-east-1 --to=eu-west1 --pct=10 --duration=10m
```
Executing now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty — incident inc_1769995555 updated: primary acked, manager acknowledged, escalation chain satisfied.

Support-Bot: Posted to status.redwood.example: "We are investigating increased error rates for hosted inference in US-East. Some customers may see 5xx responses. Reducing token limits and rolling restarts underway. Next update in 15 minutes."

Maria Chen: after restart and throttle, error rate dropped from 6.3% -> 0.9% in 8m. Memory headroom stable. Still watching for residual evictions.

Karen Lee (Manager): thanks team. Can we capture timeline and RCA notes in postmortem doc once stable? I'll open the incident in the tracker and assign follow-ups: capacity thresholds for KV cache, adaptive throttling automation, and better PD escalation SMS fallback tests.

Raj Patel: agreed. I'll keep the channel open for 30m then hand back to oncall runbook.

Maria Chen: adding a short mitigations summary for the postmortem: reduced KV cache, rolling restart, temporary token cap, traffic shift to eu-west1 canary.

Oliver Park: +1. Also recommend an alert tune: trigger when concurrent KV eviction > 1 for 5m to reduce noisy escalations.

incident-bot: PagerDuty — incident resolved? No, still monitored. Next PD check in 15m.

Support-Bot: Customer comms updated: 2 follow-up support replies acknowledging incidents, offering post-incident summary to affected customers.

Raj Patel: closing note — if we see another spike after returning to normal configs, escalate to infra team for kernel/memory tuning.

Karen Lee (Manager): good work. I'll take the postmortem ownership. Thanks all. :clap:
